hook.en: Cost depends on the number of items and so does revenue. Profit is revenue minus cost: a new function made from two others.
hook.kn: ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ಎರಡೂ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿವೆ. ಲಾಭ = ಆದಾಯ − ವೆಚ್ಚ: ಎರಡು ಫಲನಗಳಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಫಲನ.

objectives.en: Add, subtract, multiply and divide real functions
Find the domain of the result

narration.en: Cost depends on the number of items and so does revenue. Profit is revenue minus cost: a new function made from two others.
narration.kn: ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ಎರಡೂ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿವೆ. ಲಾಭ = ಆದಾಯ − ವೆಚ್ಚ: ಎರಡು ಫಲನಗಳಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಫಲನ.

body.en: For $f, g : X \to R$: $(f + g)(x) = f(x) + g(x)$, $(f - g)(x) = f(x) - g(x)$, $(fg)(x) = f(x)g(x)$, $(\alpha f)(x) = \alpha f(x)$ and $(f/g)(x) = f(x)/g(x)$ provided $g(x) \ne 0$. The new function is defined where both $f$ and $g$ are.
body.kn: ಫಲನಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಂದುವಾರು ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಗುಣಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಭಾಗಾಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ g(x) = 0 ಆಗುವ ಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡಬೇಕು.

points.en: Domain of f ± g, fg: common domain of f and g
Domain of f/g: also need g(x) ≠ 0

narration.en: We combine functions point by point: add, subtract or multiply their values. For a quotient we must also leave out the points where the denominator function is zero.
narration.kn: ಫಲನಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಂದುವಾರು ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಗುಣಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಭಾಗಾಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ g(x) = 0 ಆಗುವ ಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡಬೇಕು.

narration.en: Take f(x) = x + 1 and g(x) = x squared.

say.en: Take f(x) = x + 1 and g(x) = x squared.
Add, multiply and divide them point by point.
At x = 2: f is 3 and g is 4, so f + g is 7 and fg is 12.
On the graph, the yellow curve f + g is the white line plus the green parabola.

narration.en: f(x) = x² and g(x) = ax + b. See f + g and read the values at x₀.

caption.en: f(x) = x² and g(x) = ax + b. See f + g and read the values at x₀.

tryThis.en: Find a, b and x₀ that make (f/g)(x₀) undefined. Why does that happen?
Set a = 0: g is constant, and f + g is just f moved up by b.
Check at x₀ = 2: is (f + g)(2) = f(2) + g(2)?

problem.en: f(x) = x² and g(x) = 2x + 1. Find (f + g)(x), (f − g)(x), (fg)(x) and (f/g)(x).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. f(x) = x² and g(x) = 2x + 1. Find (f + g)(x), (f − g)(x), (fg)(x) and (f/g)(x).

problem.en: f(x) = √x and g(x) = x. Find (f/g)(x) and its domain.

steps.en: f is defined for x ≥ 0 and g for all real x.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. f(x) = √x and g(x) = x. Find (f/g)(x) and its domain.
Team quiz. Each team discusses and gives one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡವು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two competitive-exam pattern questions. Try them before we reveal the answers.
Competitive exam practice: JEE and KCET pattern questions. Some have more than one correct option, and some need a number as the answer.

points.en: The result lives on the common domain of f and g.
points.kn: ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ಪ್ರದೇಶ f ಮತ್ತು g ಗಳ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಪ್ರದೇಶ.

homework.en: f(x) = x + 1, g(x) = 2x − 3. Find (f + g)(x), (fg)(x) and (f/g)(x).

narration.en: Recap. (f ± g)(x) = f(x) ± g(x); (fg)(x) = f(x)·g(x). (f/g)(x) = f(x)/g(x) only where g(x) ≠ 0. The result lives on the common domain of f and g.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. (f ± g)(x) = f(x) ± g(x); (fg)(x) = f(x)·g(x). g(x) ≠ 0 ಆಗಿರುವಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ (f/g)(x) = f(x)/g(x). ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ಪ್ರದೇಶ f ಮತ್ತು g ಗಳ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಪ್ರದೇಶ.
